sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 120% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 40% for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Only [Hunting Time] Red Riding Hood can be used as Unlocking Potential material
